name: Caso 2 - Oferta especial por cupon H0867 en Facturacion

planSteps.description: Click 'Iniciar Sesión con Microsoft'. On the Microsoft page type 'desarrollopy@pycca.com', click 'Next', type the password 'cdPY2027!*', click 'Sign in', and click 'Yes' if a 'Stay signed in?' prompt appears
The authenticated POS dashboard is visible (cards 'Facturación', 'Entrega de Caja', 'Historial de impresión')

PRECONDITION: click 'IR' on 'Facturación'. If a red notification says 'No puede acceder a esta funcionalidad porque tiene entregas de caja pendientes', go back to the dashboard, open 'Entrega de Caja', click 'Procesar', complete the 'Autorización de Administrador' modal by typing the exact text '%21310300;432940;JAIME GABRIEL HURTADO ALVAREZ' into the 'Tarjeta de administrador' field followed by Enter (the leading '%' and the Enter are mandatory), then type '1979' in 'Clave de administrador' and click 'Confirmar'. Accept the success dialog and retry opening Facturación until it opens

NOTE: there is no 'Proformas' module in POSCLICK 1.12.0-rc.1 (verified against the dashboard search, its 15 cards and the 9 side-menu categories). The special-offer mechanism is the '# Cupón/Descuento' field in Facturación

load 10 articles: for each SKU (O22652, O22654, O22655, O22657, O22955, O22976, O22977, O22978, O22979, O23546) type it into the 'Buscar producto por SKU' field and press Enter; after each one set its row quantity to 3 and press Tab. If an article shows a red 'Pendiente' label, click it and fill every field (Homologacion='HOM-2026-001', Imei='359747505623812', Marca='GENERICA', Modelo='MODELO-TEST') then click 'Continuar'
Assign the customer: type '0914848171' into the 'Buscar cliente' field and click its magnifying-glass button
Type 'H0867' into the '# Cupón/Descuento' field in the right panel and click its magnifying-glass (apply) button

The system validates the coupon: EITHER a discount greater than $0.00 appears in the 'Descuento' line of the totals panel, OR a notification reads 'Cupón de descuento - No existen promociones asociadas al cupon ingresado'. Report which of the two occurred

If the coupon was accepted, click 'Continuar', select 'EFECTIVO', click 'Agregar', click 'Continuar', click 'Procesar', fill 'Recibido' with the exact amount shown in 'Pagar', press Tab and click 'Aceptar'
If the coupon applied, a 'Transacción finalizada' confirmation is shown and the invoice is issued with the discount reflected
